overview_description.description: Aerotime helps you be more productive by reducing context switching. We do this by automatically grouping your meetings together, creating dedicated time on your calendar for individual tasks, and shutting down all notifications when you need to focus. Done across the team, it saves countless hours and helps teams run faster (and happier).  You'll always be in flow with Aerotime, because you'll be going deep into similar tasks in one go and are easily visualize your week's plan which will not let you get distracted from the task in hand.
